title: Chapter frontmatter
description: Metadata carried in the YAML frontmatter of a chapter file under chapters/. The body stays pure Markdown prose.

id.description: Chapter-local scene id, zero-padded in narrative order, e.g. s01.

target_chars.description: Target prose length for this scene, measured according to count_unit.

goal.description: Observable dramatic purpose of the scene; not a prose summary.

id.description: Chapter id, format vVV-cCCC zero-padded, e.g. v01-c003.

word_count.description: Legacy prose count retained for v0.1 compatibility. New repositories should use prose_count and count_unit.

target_chars.description: Target chapter prose length using count_unit. For a Chinese web-novel chapter this is commonly 6000 han_chars.

count_unit.description: How prose_count, target_chars, and scene target_chars are measured.

state_after.description: Stable identifier for the complete .novel/state/ snapshot after this chapter. It may be a project-defined content/tree hash or deliberate staging ID, but MUST NOT require the Git commit containing this frontmatter to include its own hash.

foreshadow_planted.description: Foreshadow ids first planted on-page in this chapter.

foreshadow_resolved.description: Foreshadow ids paid off or resolved on-page in this chapter.

status.description: draft = written but not through the review gate; reviewed = review record has no unresolved blocking findings; final = locked.

scene_types.description: Legacy chapter-level style selectors. Prefer scenes[].type for scene-planned chapters.

scenes.description: Ordered scene plan. A writing agent drafts and reviews one scene at a time before chapter finalization.
